title: Update ShoppingListFiles Helper Signatures and Bracketing
description: Add folderURL parameters to ShoppingListFiles.readText and writeText, bracket startAccessingSecurityScopedResource on folderURL instead of the file URL, and update entry/exit logs to include folder path and didStart.
acceptance_criteria: ShoppingListFiles.readText has signature accepting from url and folderURL.
ShoppingListFiles.writeText has signature accepting text, destination url, and folderURL.
Both helpers call startAccessingSecurityScopedResource on folderURL only.
Both helpers stop accessing folderURL only when didStart is true.
Logs include file identity, folder URL path, and didStart on exit.
